articles.title: Galán, "ilusionado" con el Mundial, apura plazos para jugar con España
articles.standfirst: El español, que se lesionó en octavos de Milán, mantiene reposo por las molestias en la mano, este miércoles pasará revisión con un especialista y el viernes tomará la decisión final.
articles.summary: El español, que se lesionó en octavos de Milán, mantiene reposo por las molestias en la mano, este miércoles pasará revisión con un especialista y el viernes tomará la decisión final.
articles.body: “Va día a día, pero está ilusionado con poder estar”, es la última hora que ha podido conocer MARCA sobre el estado de forma de Ale Galán y su posible o no ausencia en el Mundial de Doha que empieza en apenas cinco días. Y es que Galán, que tuvo que comunicar su ausencia de última hora para el Major de Kuwait, apura los plazos para recuperarse de una lesión en la mano derecha y este mismo miércoles pasará consulta con un especialista siguiendo el proceso de recuperación pautado para poder evaluar el estado de su dolencia. Según ha podido saber este periódico, y a pesar de las especulaciones malintencionadas creadas en los últimos días, el madrileño sufrió molestias en octavos de final del Milán P1, las comunicó a su equipo, pero pudo seguir en competición hasta caer en semifinales sin que se agravara el dolor sufrido ante Valenzuela y Gil. No sería hasta la semana post torneo, ya en Madrid, cuando el español volvería a sentir dolor en la misma mano y se vería obligado a tomar la decisión de parar la actividad y ponerse en manos de especialistas de cara a el reinicio de la competición tras la gira europea. “Le ha dolido mucho tener que perderse el torneo en Kuwait”, aseguran a Marca fuentes cercanas al jugador y que salen en defensa del exnúmero uno en un momento crítico de la temporada pues su baja en el tercer grande de la temporada supone haber perdido la última opción de mantener sus opciones de número uno junto a Chingotto. La dolencia, que “no es una lesión”, parece ser leve, pero podría agravarse de no tratarse con “reposo e inactividad” y desde el equipo médico del jugador han preferido ser cautos para preservar la salud del ‘Alien’ pensando no solo en el corto plazo y sí en la carrera de un jugador de 30 años que atraviesa el mejor momento de su carrera. Una realidad que no descarta, ni mucho menos, a Galán de cara al Mundial de Doha, pero cuya participación no está garantizada y cuya decisión se tomará este mismo viernes antes de que finalice el plazo de inscripciones que permite a España sustituirle en caso de ausencia. “Ale quiere estar y poder jugar con España”, confirman a MARCA desde el entorno del jugador despejando cualquier duda sobre su compromiso con la Selección, pero que prefieren ser cautos sabedores de que la decisión final la tomará el equipo médico. La Federación Española de Pádel (FEP) está al tanto del estado de forma y en contacto permanente con el jugador y su entorno para conocer los plazos y su evolución y por el momento no se plantean un plan B para sustituirle. Según apuntan fuentes de la Selección a este periódico Javi Leal y Momo González son los nombres en cartera y a la espera que formaron parte de la preselección de Juanjo Gutiérrez y que entrarían entre los ocho elegidos en caso de una baja de última hora.

articles.title: Jeremy Jacquet: Liverpool gamble on defender is paying off
articles.summary: Liverpool beat Chelsea to the signing of Jeremy Jacquet and the defender is thriving at Anfield. Things could have been very different...
articles.body:
Jeremy Jacquet's choice of song for his Instagram post after Liverpool beat Brighton on Sunday and kept their fourth clean sheet of the season was telling.

"Trust in the process, trust in the plan" were some of the lyrics, accompanying a selection of images from the game.

That is very much what the 21-year-old has been doing - and more - since joining Liverpool in a deal worth £60m over the summer.

Things could have been very different had Liverpool pressed further with their pursuit of Leny Yoro in 2024. Yet in going down that route, they were alerted to another French centre-back in Jacquet, who was playing for Rennes.

Yoro chose to move to Manchester United from Lille and could well go on to be an elite centre-half but on Sunday afternoon, it was hard not to notice the difference between the pair.

Yoro, 20, made a calamitous error as United lost to Bournemouth while Jacquet put in another assured performance against Brighton . The ease with which he has adapted to playing for Liverpool has been impressive and even surprised senior figures at the club.

Liverpool great Alan Hansen, who was watching on at Anfield on Sunday, would surely have taken satisfaction from Jacquet's display.

Since arriving at Anfield, Jacquet has started every game in the Premier League and Champions League, playing more minutes (956) than any player at Liverpool bar Alisson (990) this season.

The transition is even more remarkable considering he spent most of the year recovering from injuries, having sustained a broken shoulder in February followed by a knee problem in the summer.

Jacquet did not play a minute of Liverpool 's summer tour to the United States and made his debut in a pre-season friendly against Como, when he scored at Anfield just a week before the Premier League started.

After the departure of Ibrahima Konate to Real Madrid, Liverpool had a space to fill at centre-back alongside Virgil van Dijk and given the injury struggles of Joe Gomez and Giovanni Leoni, Jacquet got the nod the following weekend at Newcastle .

A trip to St James' Park for a first Premier League experience is quite the task and, despite conceding early on, it was an encouraging display in which Jacquet played more accurate passes and successful final-third passes than any other player in the first half.

Losing to Manchester City and Erling Haaland was a timely reminder of the challenges ahead but, on the whole, he has excelled.

The way in which the Frenchman dealt with Brentford 's Igor Thiago a week later was a real standout, while social media compared his short sleeves and gloves look against Brighton to French great Marcel Desailly.

Jacquet has four clean sheets in the Premier League, ranks fourth in the top flight when it comes to interceptions (15), fourth in blocks (10) and has made more tackles (19) than any of his Liverpool team-mates.

With his stellar start to the campaign, a France call-up was inevitable under Zinedine Zidane and a debut followed for the boy from Bondy - the same area in the Paris suburbs that is home to Kylian Mbappe and William Saliba.

"Very good. Very, very good," said Zidane, when he was asked about Jacquet's performance against Italy earlier this month. "Brave. He wasn't afraid to come out a long way. Very good in the duels. He was, once again, very good. I said it four times."

On Wednesday, Liverpool will welcome Xabi Alonso back to Anfield when Chelsea visit in the Carabao Cup. Jacquet could easily have been wearing blue had Liverpool not accelerated their push for him in January

Chelsea were keen and Jacquet was rated highly internally at Stamford Bridge but he chose the Reds.

At the time, the move raised eyebrows, particularly for a player who had only made 36 appearances in France's Ligue 1.

Liverpool missed out on Marc Guehi last summer and were having a poor season but Richard Hughes, the former sporting director, was prepared to wait until the summer, with Rennes unwilling to sanction a move in January.

On deadline day in January, journalist Julien Laurens, told BBC Sport: "It's a lot of money but Jacquet has everything to become one of the best centre-backs in the world in the next few years. He is arguably the best centre-back of his generation."

A few months into the new season, it seems Liverpool have settled on a gem.

Jacquet is part of a quartet at Anfield, alongside Bradley Barcola, Victor Munoz and Ronald Araujo, taking English lessons and like everything else, he is understood to be taking that in his stride.

He lives in Liverpool and spends a lot of his time with fellow youngsters including Rio Ngumoha and Trey Nyoni, and those at the AXA Training Centre say he is mature and confident off the pitch, just like he is on the pitch.

Having two experienced figures in Van Dijk and Araujo either side of him on the field has certainly helped but in the space of a few months, Jacquet has made himself one of the first names on the teamsheet.

He went off early in the first few games as he worked built his fitness up but there are no such concerns any more.

"Our relationship is good. It's getting better every day that we work together. That's what I said from day one. It takes games especially but also training sessions and conversations off the pitch," said Van Dijk, 35, who is the only Liverpool defender to ever cost more than Jacquet.

"There's good moments and not, but it's how we react and help each other and you can see the partnership coming along.

"He's doing very well. Let's see where the ceiling will be. I don't think he's there yet so let's keep going."

articles.title: FPL: Can clubs stop players' friends and family leaking Premier League team news?
articles.summary: Chelsea striker Joao Pedro's injury was leaked through the Fantasy Premier League game, but is there anything clubs can do?
articles.body:
Chelsea head coach Xabi Alonso was caught off guard after Saturday's loss to Tottenham when asked whether he was aware that Joao Pedro's injury had been leaked through the popular Fantasy Premier League game.

His response was: "I am not into the fantasy team thing, so I didn't know that."

Accounts believed by FPL trackers to belong to Chelsea staff, a player and a relative of a player appeared to transfer out or bench Joao Pedro before the deadline.

One Fantasy Premier League manager, known online as FPL Karim, was among those who believed they had identified information by tracking selections made by a relative of Chelsea forward Morgan Rogers.

He said: "There were rumours that a player was missing from Chelsea 's attack. I went to check Rogers' team, but he'd sold Joao Pedro two or three gameweeks earlier when he was injured. He never bought him back.

"Then I checked his brother's FPL team and saw that he'd sold Joao Pedro that gameweek and brought in Nicolas Jackson. I thought it was a bit weird. Why would you sell him when he's one of the most-owned forwards in the game?

"That's when I felt maybe it was Joao Pedro who was missing out. I posted about it, it went viral, and that was basically it."

Confirmation of the injury emerged after the FPL deadline had passed, meaning 1.7 million managers had already selected Joao Pedro as captain, which doubles a player's points return.

The absence also came as a surprise to many following Chelsea 's 2-0 defeat by Tottenham , given Joao Pedro had been pictured in training during the week before the match.

Alonso later said the striker had missed the game because of "fluid on his thigh".

'Some players have started using aliases'

Alonso is one of a number of managers who have become increasingly guarded when discussing team news in media conferences.

Last month, he said: "I prefer not to give more information than needed."

On that occasion, his side went on to lose 3-0 at Brentford , having kept several injury concerns, including one involving Joao Pedro, under wraps.

Yet such is the popularity of Fantasy Premier League - a game played by more than 11 million people according to official figures - that many staff members, players and relatives of footballers also take part.

By identifying leagues or teams linked to players, staff or family members through the game, which provides an open database of participants, it can be possible to infer what is happening behind closed doors at various training grounds.

Previously, the highest-profile case involved Jack Grealish's absence from Aston Villa 's match against Leicester City in February 2021.

Leicester's manager at the time, Brendan Rodgers, admitted he had heard about the issue before the match, while Villa boss Dean Smith reportedly banned figures inside the club from playing FPL after the 2-1 defeat.

Later that year, Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola described the situation as "unethical and unprofessional".

There have been many further examples, claiming to suggest players from clubs like Arsenal , Liverpool , Leicester and Newcastle made revelatory changes to their teams.

Often that information is widely shared on social media, but it is also known that some top FPL players will withhold information for smaller circles to gain a competitive advantage in the game itself.

BBC Sport was able to find accounts that trackers claim are linked to staff, players and family members at clubs across the Premier League.

One of the experts in finding these club-linked accounts is FPL Focal, who told BBC Sport: "I am sure there are many more that have not been found. I have noticed some players have started using aliases. I've also had a couple of requests over the years to remove accounts, which I have always respected.

"The FPL leaderboard is completely public, so it is straightforward to look players up. Verifying that an account genuinely belongs to a player takes a bit more time."

Chelsea were subjected to three significant team news leaks during Liam Rosenior's short-lived tenure.

Two came before each leg of Chelsea 's record 8-2 aggregate Champions League defeat by Paris St-Germain, while the third occurred before the Englishman's final game in charge.

Remarkably, it later emerged that former defender Marc Cucurella's barber had revealed both Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro were unavailable because of injury.

Since then, Chelsea have reminded players to be careful about who they share information with before matches.

The club have also strengthened security measures at the training ground, including building new fencing around first-team pitches.

Chelsea appeared to have got on top of their leak problems earlier this season, but the Joao Pedro episode serves as a reminder that information can still emerge in unexpected ways.

Clubs can remind players and staff to be careful about what they share and with whom, while some may seek to discourage employees from selecting players from their own club in Fantasy Premier League. The nuclear option would be to ban the game entirely.

There is no league-wide rule against people involved in the sport playing the game and the Premier League defers any issues that emerge as a club matter.

Yet any measures are likely to have limitations.

While clubs can influence staff behaviour, monitoring the activity of players' friends and family members is considerably more difficult.

articles.title: Cuti Romero: "Le daría el 10 de Argentina a Julián Alvarez"
articles.standfirst: El nuevo capitán de la Albiceleste tras la retirada de Messi le otorga la responsabilidad de su selección al delantero del Atlético de Madrid
articles.summary: El nuevo capitán de la Albiceleste tras la retirada de Messi le otorga la responsabilidad de su selección al delantero del Atlético de Madrid
articles.body: Cristian Romero, el Cuti, ya habla como uno de los líderes de la nueva Argentina. Ya lo era, pero ahora convertido en capitán de la Albiceleste tras la retirada de Leo Messi. El central rojiblanco repasó en una entrevista con Los Edul el futuro de la selección, la herencia del '10' y sus propios desafíos, tanto con la camiseta argentina como en el Atlético de Madrid. Uno de los momentos más llamativos llegó cuando fue preguntado por el próximo dueño de la mítica camiseta número 10. Mientras en Argentina sigue abierto el debate sobre quién debe heredar el dorsal de Messi, el defensa fue claro al señalar a su favorito: "Yo se la daría a Julián. Tiene humildad, es familiar, es un buen chico y tiene las condiciones. Son cosas importantes para llevar la 10", aseguró sobre Julián Álvarez, aunque admitió que el delantero siempre ha mostrado su deseo de mantener el número que le ha acompañado en los últimos años. Romero también defendió la figura de Messi al ser cuestionado sobre el Balón de Oro. El zaguero considera que el premio ha evolucionado hacia criterios cada vez más mediáticos y sostiene que el argentino sigue estando por encima de cualquier comparación. "Hoy el Balón de Oro es un poco marketing. Lo que hacía Leo no se lo vi a nadie", afirmó. Y cuando le preguntaron a quién votaría este año, ni siquiera dudó: "A Messi. Aunque no se pueda, se lo doy a Messi". El nuevo capitán insistió en que el exjugador del Inter Miami deja un vacío imposible de llenar. "Otro Leo no va a haber, ni como capitán ni como número 10", señaló. Sin embargo, cree que la fortaleza del grupo permitirá afrontar el relevo generacional. "No tenemos un Leo, pero tenemos una familia", resumió al hablar del vestuario construido durante la etapa más exitosa de la historia reciente de la selección. Entre los jugadores llamados a liderar esa transición destacó a Nico Paz. Lejos de mostrarse sorprendido por la explosión del joven mediapunta, Romero explicó que ya veía ese potencial durante las concentraciones con Argentina. "Tiene unas condiciones enormes. Va a depender de él hasta dónde llegue, pero las condiciones las tiene. Es muy completo", destacó. El defensa también analizó la derrota ante España en la final del Mundial, uno de los episodios más dolorosos de su trayectoria. Romero rechazó las excusas, aunque explicó que Argentina llegó muy castigada físicamente al encuentro decisivo. "En la final no pasó nada. Las redes sociales hacen que uno suba una boludez y se haga viral. España hizo bien las cosas, nosotros llegamos con lo justo, no sé si decirle milagro pero nos costó desde lo físico todo el Mundial. Varios llegamos con lo justo, como yo", reconoció. El central reveló además que él mismo disputó la final infiltrado por problemas en el tendón de Aquiles y que varios compañeros arrastraban importantes molestias durante el torneo. Pese al golpe, asegura marcharse con la conciencia tranquila. "No me arrepiento de nada. Di todo de mí para aportar mi granito de arena al grupo", afirmó al repasar una competición en la que también recordó la lesión de rodilla que estuvo a punto de dejarle fuera del Mundial. A nivel de clubes, Romero volvió a mostrar su ambición con el Atlético de Madrid. Recién aterrizado en el conjunto rojiblanco, entiende que la única forma de dejar huella es levantando títulos. "La única manera de dejar mi nombre escrito en este club es ganando algo", aseguró. El argentino se mostró encantado con su nueva etapa y definió al Atlético como una auténtica "casa" para él y su familia. Eso sí, mientras sueña con triunfar a las órdenes de Simeone, tampoco esconde cuál quiere que sea el último gran capítulo de su carrera. El internacional mantiene intacta su intención de regresar algún día a Belgrano. "Si vuelvo, voy a volver al cien por cien", prometió.

articles.title: Iker Muniain ensalza la formación humana del Athletic a sus futbolistas
articles.standfirst: El técnico del Salamanca felicita de manera especial a Simón y De la Fuente por sus premios
articles.summary: El técnico del Salamanca felicita de manera especial a Simón y De la Fuente por sus premios
articles.body: La Gala del Balón de Oro continúa con eco entre aquellos que sintieron un cosquilleo de emoción con las palabras de Unai Simón. El elegido como mejor portero del mundo ofreció un sentido discurso en el que puso en valor el aprendizaje y la condición humana del futbolista por encima de los logros deportivos. Iker Munian, ahora entrenador del Salamanca, es uno de esos futbolistas crecidos como personas en el plan de formación del club. Él también estuvo muy cerca de Koldo Asua, la persona ya fallecida a la que nombró Simón en su parlamento como gran formador. Muniain (560 partidos y 15 temporadas en el Athletic) hizo un inciso en la rueda de prensa previa al partido de Copa frente al Celta para destacar que “dio un discurso muy emocionante. Me encantó y demostró, una vez más, lo que es tanto a nivel profesional como personal. En cierta manera hay que felicitar también al Athletic por tener en sus filas al mejor portero del mundo y formar a este tipo de jugadores, que para un club como el Athletic es muy importante. Los valores que el Athletic trata de transmitir desde que somos pequeños y vamos creciendo hasta que nos hacemos mayores son muy importantes. El Athletic tiene mucho mérito. La grandeza del club es incalculable y es un lujo tener a un representante como Unai Simón a los ojos del mundo”. El que fuera capitán del Athletic destacó el éxito del fútbol español. “Estamos en un momento de enhorabuena por todos los premios individuales y colectivos que se obtuvieron. Es para estar contentos. Es bonito y una invitación para que cada uno de nosotros, desde donde nos toque, mantengamos esa ambición para pelear por cosas importantes y poner en valor al fútbol español”. Y extendió una felicitación más personal a De la Fuente: “tuve la suerte de coincidir con él en mi etapa de jugador del Bilbao Athletic y luego en muchas de las distintas categorías de la selección española. Ojalá pueda seguir consiguiendo cosas importantes”.

articles.title: Former Liverpool forward Dirk Kuyt appointed Fenerbahce interim coach
articles.summary: Former Netherlands forward Dirk Kuyt is appointed Fenerbahce’s interim coach a week before they face his former club Liverpool in the Champions League.
articles.body:
Former Netherlands forward Dirk Kuyt has been appointed Fenerbahce's interim coach a week before they face his former club Liverpool in the Champions League.

The 46-year-old is stepping up to the role after being the assistant of Ismail Kartal, who resigned as the Turkish club's manager following the side's 2-1 defeat by arch rivals Galatasaray on Monday.

Fenerbahce said , external Kuyt, who won the Turkish league title with the club as a player in 2013-14, would hold the post "until a new head coach is appointed".

Kuyt's first game will be a league match against Goztepe on Saturday before Fenerbahce host Liverpool in a Champions League group stage tie on Wednesday, 4 November (17:45 GMT).

The Dutchman spent six years with the Anfield side, , external winning the League Cup with the Reds in 2012 and scoring 71 goals for them in 285 appearances.

He went on to have a three-year stint at Fenerbahce and, after a spell at Feyenoord, retired as a player in 2017.

Kuyt held managerial posts at ADO Den Haag, Beerschot and FC Dordrecht before becoming Fenerbahce assistant , external in June 2026.

Kartal had previously stepped down as manager in September but had stayed in the post after his resignation, on that occasion, was not accepted.

Kuyt takes over with Fenerbahce fifth in the Turkish top-flight and six points behind leaders Galatasaray.

articles.title: Emmanuel Latte Lath interview: Union Berlin striker on memories of Michael Carrick, Lionel Messi and his mental coach
articles.summary: In this interview with Emmanuel Latte Lath, the Union Berlin striker discusses working with Michael Carrick at Middlesbrough, Lionel Messi, his difficulties in MLS with Atlanta and why he is now working with a mental coach to help fulfil his potential in the Bundesliga
articles.body:
It was a simple header against Eintracht Frankfurt but for Latte Lath it was much more than that. It was the culmination of a journey that began in the Republic of Cote d'Ivoire before emigrating to Italy at eight years old. More recently, it was a career that had stalled.

His transfer from Middlesbrough to Major League Soccer club Atlanta last year was worth £22.5m and all the pressure that this brings. Asked about the big move by Sky Sports, Latte Lath says: "It was difficult because I came there with a lot of expectation."

He explains: "It became really, really difficult. I really felt it on my skin, on my journey, on my career." Eleven goals in 48 games was no disgrace. But everyone, himself included, hoped for much more. "I really wanted to show them why I arrived there. And it did not work."

There were memories that made him smile. He got to play against Lionel Messi, for example. "I was really like a kid when you see your hero. It was unbelievable. I will never forget it. I also touched him. I could touch Messi," he says, laughing at the thought.

But when Latte Lath talks more generally about regrets, it is tempting to think he regards his move as a misstep at a major moment. "You have to remember why you started. People around you will really, really affect a lot your decisions and your career."

When asked what advice he would give his younger self, Latte Lath replies: "Honestly, what I could say to him, I just could say maybe take more decisions for myself, not let people take decisions for me. This is the main thing I can say to the young Emmanuel."

After starting out at Atalanta in Italy, he had a number of loans, most notably with Swiss club St Gallen where he scored 14 top-flight goals, but it was at Middlesbrough where he really flourished. Sixteen strikes in his debut Championship season raised his profile.

What was it about life at Boro that brought out the best in him? "I think the main thing is that it is a family club. So I left my family in Italy and I came and I found another family. So, this was, for me, the main thing. So, they found me and gave me [help] to push on."

Michael Carrick was the coach in charge for all 29 of Latte Lath's Boro goals. What did he think of him? "I think he is a calm, calm coach and he kind of observes everything. And observing him, he tried to take the best out of yourself. That is the main thing."

Carrick finds himself in the eye of a storm at Manchester United. How does Latte Lath believe that his former boss will deal with the difficult moments? "From my experience, when we were in the difficult situation, he never screamed like crazy," he reveals.

"He just tried to analyse the moment and analyse the players and help us talk. Like saying, 'OK, now we're in a difficult moment, we have to try to do this, this, this'. And this was the main thing because he knew how to listen to us and also how to speak with us."

Learning to open up about his thoughts and feelings has been important for Latte Lath. He is working with a mental coach. "In the beginning, I was, like, I don't trust him, you know? But he helped me a lot. It is not just, I have to do this, do that. It is just talking."

He adds: "It is trying to know me, understanding what I need. For me, it is really helpful because I do not just use him for work with my job but also in real life. To become a man because I became a father. It is something new for me and really, really helpful."

Life in the Bundesliga with Union Berlin is new for him too. "New coach, new system, new everything." And he is aware it is a step up. "It is intense, it's hard work and you have no time to kind of rest or think." And after that debut goal, it has been a test for Union.

Latte Lath has already faced Bayer Leverkusen, Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund this season. Asked about playing against Harry Kane, he says: "When you play and you lose, you are not happy. But football is a journey for learning things," he explains.

"So, as a striker, I always try to steal something. Maybe some movement, some action, to see how they think in a pressing situation." He adds: "As a striker, I am the first defender so I want to bring this." And to become a leader. "This is the main thing for me."

The past year has been "a bit tough" by his own admission. But he has learned "to never give up" and is ready for the next challenge. It has been some journey. But a journey of self-realisation too. "Honestly, I cannot do it alone. The people around me help a lot."

articles.title: Ramón Álvarez de Mon, sobre el error millonario en Valdebebas: "Es una chapuza tremenda"
articles.standfirst: El tertuliano de La Tribu analiza el fallo en el informe económico del proyecto tecnológico de Valdebebas y defiende la operación del Real Madrid
articles.summary: El tertuliano de La Tribu analiza el fallo en el informe económico del proyecto tecnológico de Valdebebas y defiende la operación del Real Madrid
articles.body: El proyecto para convertir parte de los terrenos de Valdebebas en un gran distrito tecnológico ha generado polémica por un error en los cálculos económicos. Ramón Álvarez de Mon ha explicado en La Tribu de Radio MARCA las cifras que aparecen en el informe elaborado para justificar el retorno económico de la operación al Ayuntamiento de Madrid. "Es una chapuza tremenda, la verdad", ha asegurado el tertuliano. Según ha explicado Álvarez de Mon, el objetivo es crear un gran centro tecnológico, similar a Silicon Valley, en unos terrenos de Valdebebas. Una operación por la que el Ayuntamiento recibirá 25 hectáreas cedidas por el Real Madrid para uso público. Sin embargo, el informe económico contiene un importante error de cálculo. "En lugar de multiplicar el valor catastral por 0,001, multiplicamos por 0,1, que es como calcular el 10% en lugar del 0,1", ha detallado. El fallo provocó que las previsiones de ingresos municipales se dispararan. "El rendimiento económico cada año para el Ayuntamiento era, de acuerdo con ese cálculo, de 98 millones de euros en lugar de 1,7, que creo que va a ser", ha explicado. Pese a ello, considera que el proyecto podría seguir estando justificado por la actividad económica y la inversión que generaría. "Almeida ha dicho que en ningún caso se pensaba que se iba a ganar ese dinero, pero es una chapuza, que no se había detectado", ha añadido. Álvarez de Mon también ha salido en defensa de la operación del club blanco. "Ningún ciudadano va a pagar con sus impuestos nada al Madrid", ha asegurado, antes de recordar las características de los terrenos y los acuerdos del club con grandes compañías tecnológicas. "Si hay alguien que puede presentar una oferta análoga a la del Madrid, es decir, unos terrenos al lado del aeropuerto, al lado de IFEMA, con un club que trabaja con las 15 tecnológicas más importantes del mundo", ha señalado, mencionando empresas como Apple y Microsoft. Por último, el tertuliano ha defendido que cualquier otra entidad pueda competir en las mismas condiciones. "Yo por supuesto como ciudadano madrileño, aunque sea gallego, lo que quiero es que puedan competir en igualdad con el Real Madrid", ha afirmado. Sin embargo, ha cuestionado que existan muchas alternativas capaces de ofrecer una operación similar, especialmente por la cesión de 25 hectáreas para uso público al Ayuntamiento.

articles.title: Bruno Fernandes: Man Utd head coach Michael Carrick and club captain hold clear-the-air talks ahead of Chelsea fixture
articles.summary: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes was an unused substitute in their 3-0 defeat against Bournemouth after being dropped by Michael Carrick; Man Utd head coach will take charge of Saturday's game against Chelsea with Fernandes now in contention after talks on Tuesday
articles.body:
Fernandes was an unused substitute after being dropped for the 3-0 defeat against Bournemouth on Sunday after he criticised Carrick's tactics following the 4-1 thrashing at Como in the Champions League.

Carrick had described his reasons for dropping his captain as "pure football".

"Picking the team is always a difficult decision," Carrick told Sky Sports . "We've got to make what we feel is the right one for the team to try to get the performance we want."

However, Carrick and Fernandes met at United's training ground on Tuesday, Sky Sports News has been told, for an open and frank discussion, with the head coach satisfied the animosity between them is over, although it is not known if the midfielder apologised for his public criticism.

Fernandes is now expected to be in contention for United's Premier League game against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge on Saturday.

The individual meeting between Carrick and Fernandes was in addition to an all-squad meeting, where there was a renewed determination from all the players and staff that performances have to improve immediately.

There was also a mutual admission, we are told, that there has been a squad-wide underperformance so far this season.

Carrick and the Man Utd players have been given the chance to turn their form around despite the under-pressure head coach thought to be on the brink after Sunday's defeat.

'Fernandes back to his best in training'

Sky Sports News' Danyal Khan at Carrington:

"Bruno Fernandes is absolutely back in contention. From what I understand and what I've been told from sources around Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes has been back to his best in the last 48 hours.

"Now, what does that mean, and how has that come around?

"It was quite out of character, you have to say, for him to come out last week, airing a lot of frustrations after the Como defeat.

"I would also assume that the reaction or lack of by the fans towards him on Sunday, when he's warming up, no shouts of Bruno from around Old Trafford, and then the boos, not just Fernandes, but also the players faced after Michael Carrick had gone down the tunnel.

"What I've been told, Bruno Fernandes has come back to Carrington since Monday. He was here on Monday to receive treatment to maintain his fitness, but since then all has seemingly been back to normal, and that is the message we have received at Manchester United, it is business as usual for everyone involved.

"I imagine he'll have a much bigger part than he did on Sunday against Bournemouth, and he is absolutely back in contention to play for Michael Carrick's side on Saturday."

Neville: Fernandes let himself down - read the room Bruno!

Following the defeat to Bournemouth, Sky Sports' Gary Neville said Fernandes had let himself down.

"Eric Cantona was very unorthodox as a captain," he said. "Roy Keane could sometimes be explosive in his interviews after matches, but they weren't whingers about the tactics, about pressing, or excuse merchants.

"Bruno can't press. To come out and whinge after the game about the manager's tactics, when you've just lost 4-1, and a few thousand fans have paid thousands of pounds to travel over in that far corner and get wet through. I'm sorry, read the room, Bruno.

"This is not a time for whinging, throwing your arms up in the air. This is a time for you to stand up and say, that's not good enough. Be positive. Do something with a positive influence as a captain. But he's not.

"He's gone and basically thrown his manager under the bus the week after [Lisandro] Martinez did the same."

Neville added: "They weren't singing for Bruno Fernandes to come on today, they're backing Michael Carrick. So get in your box. You know where you stand.

"Michael Carrick's won things for the football club on a constant basis, and proven that he can have the humility, the resilience. And Bruno has got that. Bruno has delivered for Manchester United in more ways than any other player in the last 13 years.

"And he's the one player I think you could take back in time, and I think he could play in a Manchester United team in the 90s, in the 2000s because he's massively talented. But he let himself down this week.

"He didn't need to do that, because he's basically stuck the knife into his manager."

What did Fernandes say after Como defeat?

"It's a decision from the staff to not press man to man and sometimes leave a little space in behind and try to get the ball in the first moment, to wait for them, to give them the ball," said Fernandes.

"But sometimes when you give too much the ball to these teams they get confident, they have so many bodies behind the ball that make you run a lot, make people get frustrated, and then obviously when you recover the ball the legs are, and the brain, much more difficult to make it work."

Asked if the tactics were to blame for the defeat, Fernandes replied: "That's on the manager and on the staff to see it, it's not on me.

"I just said, I think sometimes we have to be more brave on the pressure, trying to take a risk of getting that press very high and making them uncomfortable - as they did to us."

Sky Sports News reported on October 22 that Fernandes would not be stripped of the captaincy for his comments, but at his pre-Bournemouth press conference the following day, Carrick refused to rule out disciplinary measures against Fernandes.

"The most important thing for me is the team and the dynamics in the squad. It is about the football club. Whatever the situation is, I will always do what is best for the football club," he said.

"If I've spoken to him or haven't... this isn't the time to go into details."

Fernandes was the second United player to publicly criticise the club in October after Lisandro Martinez's comments following the Champions League defeat at Atletico Madrid.

Martinez said: "I expect more from our technical director [director of football, Jason Wilcox]. We expect more from the top, from upstairs, to bring in more players to compete."

Martinez was not dropped for United's following game, playing 45 minutes of the 1-1 draw at Leeds - but was also benched for the visit of Bournemouth.

articles.title: El músico de Bremen es Füllkrug: supera al último Balón de Oro... y solamente Raphinha está mejor
articles.standfirst: El delantero alemán suma 11 goles en nueve partidos esta temporada
articles.summary: El delantero alemán suma 11 goles en nueve partidos esta temporada
articles.body: A sus 33 años y después de etapas discretas en West Ham y Milan, el renacer de Niclas Füllkrug pasa por Bremen. El ariete de Hannover suma 11 goles en 9 partidos esta temporada; nadie en Alemania ha marcado más en las competiciones domésticas. Ni Harry Kane (10 tantos en 12 encuentros, contando Champions), recientemente nombrado Balón de Oro en Londres, lo iguala este curso. Sus últimos dos tantos, anoche en DFB Pokal. Su doblete, sin embargo, no pudo evitar la eliminación del Bremen ante el Dortmund. Pero para el Werder es una gran temporada: solamente una derrota en Bundesliga y sexta posición... a un punto de la 'zona Champions'. Algo que no se 'cataba' desde hace mucho tiempo en la tercera ciudad más poblada del norte de Alemania. Los datos, mientras, ratifican su buena campaña: como indica OPTA, Niclas Füllkrug marca un gol en competición oficial cada 60 minutos, lo que le sitúa por delante de todos los jugadores de las cinco principales ligas europeas... excepto Raphinha, del Barcelona, que marca cada 53 minutos. "Si Alemania necesita goles, entonces deberían convocarlo", decía Daniel Thoiune, entrenador del Werder Bremen, sobre un posible retorno de Füllkrug a la selección alemana. "Al fin y al cabo, lo importante es que los mejores jugadores de Alemania jueguen para Alemania", añadía. El propio Füllkrug, no obstante, se aleja de esos debates: "No me gusta hablar de eso. Creo que Jürgen Klopp ya ha hablado mucho al respecto durante el parón internacional, y sus convocatorias demuestran que tienen una visión de futuro. Pero si mi país me necesita, estaré ahí. Incluso a los 40 años o más, seguiría estando listo". El 'drama' para el Werder Bremen es que la cesión desde el West Ham es sin opción de compra... por lo que volverá a Londres el próximo verano, a un año de acabar su contrato (expira en junio de 2028) con los 'hammers'.

articles.title: FIFA politics around Infantino re-election push Japanese official to resign
articles.summary: Vice president Takeshi Okada said responses to several World Cup controversies did not align with his personal values.
articles.body:
The vice president of Japan’s football association has quit, saying the “series of responses” to controversies surrounding the World Cup did not align with his personal values.

Takeshi Okada, who coached Japan at the World Cup in 1998 and again in 2010, stepped down a week after the head of Asian football said the region supported Gianni Infantino’s bid for re-election as FIFA president.

Asian Football Confederation (AFC) president Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim al-Khalifa delivered the unequivocal backing at a meeting in Tokyo.

It came weeks after the AFC had joined football bodies in Europe and North America in condemning Infantino over his plan to open FIFA’s premium competitions such as the World Cup to private investors.

Infantino has faced calls to quit and lost the support of some associations in his bid to be re-elected to a fourth and final term.

Okada, who is one of three Japan Football Association (JFA) vice presidents, said he was stepping down “entirely of my own volition”.

“Throughout my career I have treasured the social value of sport based on my conviction that sport must be conducted with integrity,” he said.

“However, with regard to the series of responses surrounding the recent FIFA World Cup, there is a significant gap between those responses and my own beliefs, and as a sportsman I cannot accept them.”

Infantino, who apologised for the failed private investment project, has headed FIFA since 2016 and is running for re-election in March.

Two months ago the AFC and Sheikh Salman signalled they could turn on Infantino.

A joint letter with European body UEFA and CONCACAF, representing federations in North and Central America and the Caribbean, declared football “belongs to no individual”.

Okada said his decision had been “reached after careful and repeated deliberation”.

“Taking into account our relationship with the AFC and the impact on Japanese football, I do understand that there are practical reasons for aligning our stance with that of the AFC,” he said.

articles.title: Anatomía de un discurso ejemplar: "Unai Simón llegó al público con palabras sencillas, cercanas y honestas, supo transmitir"
articles.standfirst: El parlamento del portero, elegido mejor del mundo en la gala del Balón de Oro, también impacta en los especialistas en oratoria
articles.summary: El parlamento del portero, elegido mejor del mundo en la gala del Balón de Oro, también impacta en los especialistas en oratoria
articles.body: Se acercó al micro del London Palladium Theatre como si tocara el larguero de una portería antes de un partido. Le esperaba un discurso mundial. Para un inexperto lo normal sería falta de fluidez, nervios, un folio, pero nada de eso apareció en Unai Simón, ganador del trofeo al mejor portero del mundo y autor de un discurso en la gala del Balón de Oro que impactó a todos los presentes. Su mensaje, de 2 minutos y 20 segundos, traspasó a la audiencia y los especialistas en oratoria han analizado un discurso que entra en la historia de los parlamentos en público. Sonia Javaga, directora de formación de El Trampolín, escuela de comunicación y oratoria, responde a la pregunta "¿qué tiene que tener un discurso para emocionar y conseguir que sus palabras permanezcan en nuestra memoria?". Jávaga, actriz y coach de comunicación y oratoria, estima que Unai Simón "nos dejó algo más que un discurso de agradecimiento. Nos recordó que, para conectar con el público, no hacen falta grandes palabras ni frases extraordinarias. Hace falta tener algo que decir y saber transmitirlo". La experta recuerda cómo "estamos acostumbrados a ver a futbolistas desenvolverse con soltura en el campo y encontrar más dificultades cuando tienen un micrófono delante. Por eso llama la atención una intervención como la de Unai: por la tranquilidad con la que habla", prosigue y "por cómo consigue llegar al público con unas palabras sencillas, cercanas y honestas". En el análisis del discurso, Jávaga reconoce "tres claves que trabajamos en El Trampolín: ser uno mismo, expresarse con naturalidad y hablar desde el corazón. Parece fácil, pero ante un auditorio, con los nervios y la presión del momento, no siempre lo es". La especialista señala uno de los problemas al hablar en público: "A veces nos esforzamos tanto por estar a la altura que acabamos alejándonos de nuestra manera de hablar. Él conserva esa naturalidad que permite reconocer a la persona detrás de las palabras. Y esa es una de las razones por las que su intervención resulta tan cercana a quienes escuchamos". Jávaga incide en que "Unai transmite emoción y humildad. Está recibiendo un reconocimiento individual, pero dedica sus palabras a explicar cuánto debe ese logro a otras personas. Les hace sitio en un momento que podría haber reservado para hablar de sí mismo". Al ahondar en el estudio de las palabras de Unai sostiene otra de las claves del portero del Athletic porque "en un agradecimiento es fácil caer en una sucesión de nombres. Unai combina las referencias a personas concretas con el reconocimiento a grupos, como su cuadrilla o sus compañeros. Pero lo más interesante es que explica qué le han aportado y por qué son importantes en su vida. Eso convierte una mención en un reconocimiento. Quien recibe el agradecimiento puede sentirse valorado, y quienes escuchamos entendemos el motivo". También le hace hueco al momento en el que el portero habló de su pareja: "Cuando habla de su pareja como un 'oasis de tranquilidad', nos regala una imagen. Podemos imaginar lo que representa para él. Las imágenes hacen visible una idea y nos ayudan a recordarla". Para Jávaga, en Unai "su manera de comunicar acompaña al mensaje. La sonrisa, el tono calmado y la mirada dirigida a distintas zonas del público contribuyen a esa sensación de cercanía. Reparte su atención y deja que las palabras lleguen sin precipitarse". Es difícil tocar la perfección, ni siquiera era el objetivo del guardameta. Jävaga señala: "¿Hay aspectos que podría mejorar? Sí. Liberar las manos del atril le permitiría ganar expresividad. También podría dar más variedad a la voz y enfatizar ciertas ideas para que el tono no resultara tan uniforme. Pero lo esencial ya está: conecta". Fue mucho más que un mensaje deportivo. No había un espacio para el vacío. Por eso la especialista recalca que a reflexión de Unai "sobre el legado lleva el agradecimiento más allá de su trayectoria. Al hablar de ser recordados como buenas personas y buenos compañeros, sus palabras también tienen que ver con nosotros: ¿qué huella queremos dejar?". Jávaga recuerda que en su empresa "trabajamos la estructura, la voz, los gestos y la mirada para ayudar a cada persona a comunicar desde su forma de ser. Unai recuerda la fuerza que pueden tener unas palabras sencillas cuando nacen de un agradecimiento de verdad".

articles.title: Misterio Gavi
articles.standfirst: El canterano solamente lleva 191 minutos en esta temporada
articles.summary: El canterano solamente lleva 191 minutos en esta temporada
articles.body: Hay situaciones en el fútbol que cuesta entender, y la de Gavi empieza a ser una de ellas. El centrocampista del Barça ha pasado de ser una pieza fundamental en el equipo a tener un papel prácticamente testimonial. Las lesiones explican parte de su ausencia, pero ya no parecen suficientes para justificar una situación que empieza a resultar preocupante cuando ya se encuentra recuperado físicamente. Este debía ser el año de su regreso definitivo. Después de una lesión de rodilla que lo mantuvo alejado de los terrenos de juego durante meses y de una recaída que retrasó todavía más su vuelta, Gavi tenía por delante una temporada para recuperar sensaciones, continuidad y protagonismo. A día de hoy, está recuperado físicamente y disponible para competir, pero su participación está muy lejos de lo que cabría esperar de un futbolista de su talento. Apenas ha disputado 191 minutos en lo que va de temporada en todas las competiciones, una cifra que evidencia hasta qué punto ha perdido peso en los planes del equipo. Lo más llamativo es el contraste con el Gavi que conocíamos antes de las lesiones. Aquel centrocampista intenso, agresivo en la presión, capaz de contagiar energía al resto y de competir cada balón como si fuera el último, era mucho más que un jugador de rotación. Su carácter y su capacidad para elevar el ritmo del equipo lo habían convertido en una pieza importante tanto para el Barça como para la selección española. Ahora, en cambio, parece haber quedado relegado a un segundo plano del que le está costando salir. El Clásico fue un ejemplo especialmente significativo. En un partido de máxima exigencia, con todo lo que representa enfrentarse al Real Madrid, Gavi no disputó ni un solo minuto. Una decisión que refleja con claridad su situación actual y que invita a preguntarse qué lugar ocupa realmente en la jerarquía de la plantilla. Porque una cosa es recuperar progresivamente a un futbolista después de una lesión tan delicada y otra muy distinta es que, una vez recuperado, su presencia siga siendo prácticamente anecdótica. Además, el panorama no invita al optimismo. La competencia en el centro del campo es enorme y cada vez hay menos espacio para él. Pedri y Rodri aparecen como las principales referencias para el puesto de pivote, mientras que el regreso de Frenkie de Jong añade todavía más competencia y opciones para el entrenador. Gavi tendrá que pelear por unos minutos que, a día de hoy, parecen muy difíciles de conseguir. El tiempo pasa y necesita jugar para recuperar el ritmo, la confianza y la importancia que tuvo en el pasado. El gran interrogante ya no es si Gavi volverá a ser el de antes, sino si tendrá las oportunidades necesarias para demostrarlo. Porque recuperar la salud era el primer paso; recuperar su sitio en el Barça puede convertirse en el verdadero desafío. Es posible que tenga minutos frente al Alavés fruto de las rotaciones, la pregunta es si los seguirá teniendo ante Aston Villa y Atlético de Madrid.

articles.title: Manchester United: Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes hold clear-the-air talks
articles.summary: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick and captain Bruno Fernandes hold clear-the-air talks at the club's training ground.
articles.body:
Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick and captain Bruno Fernandes have held clear-the-air talks before the team's trip to Chelsea.

Fernandes, 32, was an unused substitute during United's 3-0 defeat by Bournemouth on Sunday.

The Portuguese was dropped to the bench after he criticised Carrick's tactics following the 4-1 loss against Como in the Champions League.

Sources have told BBC Sport that the pair spoke privately at the club's training ground on Tuesday, with the talks aimed at airing issues.

It is unclear whether Fernandes, who was made club captain in 2023, apologised for his critical comments.

United are preparing for Saturday's trip to Chelsea (12:30 GMT), when Fernandes could return to the starting line-up.

Carrick was widely expected to be sacked following the Bournemouth game, but he will take charge of the Premier League match at Stamford Bridge.

United's board decided the 45-year-old deserved the opportunity to turn things around at Old Trafford , despite the team languishing in 16th place in the Premier League.

There was further good news for Carrick on Wednesday, with midfielder Kobbie Mainoo returning to training after a fortnight out through injury.

Despite managing just one victory in eight Premier League matches this term, the predicament at the club is not seen as being entirely Carrick's fault by the board.

Senior figures at the club feel United's players - a squad they think are capable of qualifying for the Champions League - are underperforming badly and should shoulder some blame.

One player told BBC Sport: "The feeling is that we all want to put it right. Players, staff, everyone."

Nevertheless, sources have told BBC Sport that the club have shortlisted former Newcastle United boss Eddie Howe and ex-Germany and Bayern Munich head coach Julian Nagelsmann as potential replacements for Carrick.

Any decision to appoint Howe would trigger a multi-million-pound compensation claim from his former club Newcastle, while Nagelsmann is a free agent.

articles.title: Thierry Henry responds to backlash over Ballon d'Or comments
articles.summary: Former Arsenal forward Thierry Henry responds to criticism of a number of comments he made during Monday's Ballon d'Or ceremony and claims they were "jokes".
articles.body:
Thierry Henry has defended himself after criticism over the way he hosted Monday's Ballon d'Or ceremony.

The former France and Arsenal forward, who has come under fire for remarks he made towards Barcelona star Lamine Yamal, overall winner Harry Kane and co-host Kate Scott on the night, has addressed what he said was "people getting really excited about nothing".

Henry, who was presenting the ceremony alongside CBS Sports colleague Scott, joked with Lamine Yamal about him winning a third successive young player of the year award.

He also corrected Scott's pronunciation of Brazil legend Socrates' name and admitted he wanted fellow Frenchman Kylian Mbappe to beat Kane to the top prize.

Addressing the Lamine Yamal situation, which received an audible reaction from the audience in attendance, Henry said he wasn't "checking his ego" and emphasised his admiration of the young Spaniard.

On the night, he teased Lamine Yamal by saying of his young player award: "It's your third one, right? But is it the one you really wanted to win?"

Speaking in a social media video on Wednesday, Henry said: "I'm a big fan of Lamine Yamal. I wasn't checking his ego at all - that you didn't like the joke, I can understand.

"But don't do that, he's one of the players I'd pay to watch, I love him."

The 49-year-old also responded to criticism over his response to co-host Scott's pronunciation of 'Socrates', claiming she was in on the joke herself.

"You didn't like the joke, I understand, but please stop saying I disrespected Kate," Henry said.

"I will never do that and you can ask her, she was on the joke with me. She did Soc on purpose, and I said Soc, so please stop inventing stories."

Arsenal forward Bukayo Saka won the Socrates Award for his humanitarian and charity work.

Henry added Kane was a "worthy winner" of the Ballon d'Or before telling everyone to "relax" after his support of Mbappe's claim to the prize.

"I'm French and I was always going to back up and support my fellow countryman," he said.

"I said to [Kane], 'You are a worthy winner, you deserve it, you are the example that work ethic is a talent, working hard is a talent'. Well done, Harry Kane - and I call him Sir Harry Kane since the World Cup.

"So please, people out there, relax, relax. I love Harry Kane, I love Lamine Yamal and I didn't disrespect Kate. She was on the joke with me."

articles.title: Lincoln Riley: USC 'is where I want to be. This is the right place for me'
articles.summary: USC is 30-17 since going 11-3 in Riley's first season in 2022.
articles.body:
Could USC's game against No. 2 Ohio State on Saturday be a referendum on Lincoln Riley?

Perhaps no coach faces more pressure entering Week 9 than Riley. The Trojans fell out of the AP Top 25 in Week 8 with a putrid performance at Wisconsin. The USC offense had just 241 total yards — and lost yards rushing — in a 24-7 loss .

The defeat dropped USC to 6-2 ahead of the Buckeyes' Halloween visit. It also put the Trojans two games out of first in the Big Ten. A loss to Ohio State on Saturday ends any hope USC has of making the Big Ten title game for the first time.

"Listen, if I didn't want to be at this place, I wouldn't have come here in the first place," Riley said at his Tuesday news conference. "If I didn't want to be at this place — I've had plenty of opportunities to leave. This is where I want to be. This is the right place for me. I'm the right person to be here. And that's just as honest and transparent as I can be with you guys."

While Riley may think he's the right fit at USC, just how much control over his future will he have if USC loses? Ohio State enters the game without quarterback Julian Sayin. It's the first time the Buckeyes have taken the field since Sayin was lost for the year with a right shoulder injury against Indiana. Freshman QB Luke Fahey is likely to start in his place.

If USC can't take advantage of a freshman making the first start of his career, is it really a top-tier program in the Big Ten? USC hasn't lost fewer than three games in any of Riley's first four seasons since arriving from Oklahoma. And that 11-3 campaign came in his first season. Since then, USC is 30-17.

"I love it here. Like I've told you guys a lot of times, there's not many people in college football history that gave up what I gave up to come here," Riley said of his move from Oklahoma. "I don't care if it's 15 years down the line. That never shouldn't be taken lightly. It's certainly not taken likely by me. I came here because this is where I wanted to be. I came here because I believe in this place and none of that has changed whatsoever."

articles.title: Terzic: "Ver lo que pasó hace dos años tras ganar la Copa fue una de las razones que me hizo venir aquí"
articles.standfirst: El técnico rojiblanco inicia un camino de ilusión y recuerda que ganó la Copa en Alemania
articles.summary: El técnico rojiblanco inicia un camino de ilusión y recuerda que ganó la Copa en Alemania
articles.body: el Athletic abre la Copa este jueves frente al Prat, conjunto de sexta categoría que se convertirá en el primer rival de Terzic en el torneo. El alemán, que ganó la Copa en Alemania con el Borussia Dortmund, inicia camino en una competición cargada de ilusión en el mundo rojiblanco. "Sé que es una competiciòn muy importante para el club, pero también para nosotros como equipo. Cuando ves las imágenes de cuando se ganó la Copa hace dos años...fue una de las razones para venir, conocer y trabajar este club. En Alemania pude ganar la Copa en mi primera participación. Vamos a prepararla de la mejor manera posible para que nos vaya muy bien", apuntó. Rival de sexta categoría: “Hemos conseguido todos los vídeos de su temporada en Liga y los partidos de clasificación de Copa. Hemos tenido ojeadores también viéndoles y nuestros analistas lo han trabajado. No queremos diferenciar competiciones ni rivales, la única diferencia es ganar o perder. Para uno de los dos equipos no habrá un mañana en la competición y por eso hemos tratado de prepararlo con el máximo respeto. En el deporte no me gusta la palabra temor, si el respeto. La magia de la Copa es que siempre se dan este tipo de partidos y sensaciones. Ocurrió también ayer en Inglaterra con el Arsenal. Por eso todo el mundo se enamora de la Copa, donde todo es posible. Queremos ser un equipo profesional para mostrar un rendimiento sólido. Si lo hacemos como el domingo en San Mamés tendremos una alta posibilidad de seguir adelante”. El derbi, a la vista: “Sabemos qué nos espera, pero antes tenemos un partido de Copa. Ya hablaremos del derbi a la vuelta de la Copa. Tenemos un gran grupo de jugadores y tengo mucha confianza en cada uno de ellos. Mañana pondremos un equipo muy fuerte para demostrar que queremos estar en la siguiente ronda. Llevamos la camiseta del Athletic y eso ya tiene que ser suficiente reto para demostrar lo que somos”. Jugar en hierba artificial: “Es algo que forma parte de este desafío. No me gusta que les hayan cambiado de estadio, pero lo han tenido que hacer por seguridad. Lo del césped artificial está ahí y es una superficie común a los inicios de cada uno de nuestros jugadores”. Las herramientas del Prat: “Tenemos el mayor respeto por la competición y el rival. No están aquí por una lotería. No me gusta hablar de nombres, pero me he preparado. El año pasado tuvieron un final de temporada complicado. Conocemos su sistema de juego, defienden en 4-2-3-1 y ya digo que trataremos de plantar cara a cada desafío”. La recuperación de Sancet y Galarreta: “Sancet ha hecho todo el entrenamiento con nosotros y algo extra, pero no sería buena idea jugar un jueves en césped artificial. Estará disponible para el domingo y eso es una buena noticia. Galarreta está fuera. Hoy ha empezado a correr de nuevo en el campo. Le esperamos para la semana siguiente, para el partido ante Osasuna, aunque es un objetivo optimista”.

articles.title: Ballon d’Or win will help keep Kane at Bayern, says Germany’s Matthaus
articles.summary: Former World Cup winner Lothar Matthaus says relationship between Harry Kane and club Bayern Munich is ‘perfect’.
articles.body:
Winning the Ballon d’Or will help persuade Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane to extend his deal with the German champions, former World Cup winner Lothar Matthaus said.

On Monday, Kane became the first Englishman to win the prestigious award – the top individual honour in the sport – since Michael Owen in 2001.

The England captain was prolific last season, scoring 61 goals in 51 games for Bayern across all competitions as the German side completed a domestic league and cup double. He was also a World Cup semifinalist with England, scoring six goals in the tournament.

“We are very happy to have Harry Kane in the Bundesliga. He is an international ambassador of football,” Matthaus, who won the award in 1990 after leading Germany to World Cup victory that year, said in an online media roundtable.

“Maybe he was dreaming to win the Ballon d’Or … but you have to play in a big club like Bayern. He found his peace in Munich and the right club with the right teammates.”

Kane, 33, joined Bayern in 2023 in a 100-million-euro ($111m) move from boyhood club Tottenham Hotspur, in search of silverware. He has since won the league twice and is in talks with Bayern over a new contract.

“I think he gets a bonus (for winning the Ballon d’Or); 36 years ago I got nothing,” Matthaus said. “But it is about more than money. It is a good moment to sign (a new deal) for Bayern. Bayern helped him get this Ballon d’Or.

“The relationship between Harry Kane and Bayern Munich is perfect, and with everything that has happened in the last three years, I think Harry will sign his contract for the next two, three years.”

Bayern, top of the Bundesliga standings, take on Magdeburg on Wednesday in the German Cup second round.

articles.body: El técnico del Deportivo habló en la previa ante el Auriense orensano de categoría regional de que la Copa es un torneo que le encanta. “Siempre es bueno competir en la Copa del Rey. Me parece una competición bonita. Todo se iguala muchísimo a un partido y será complicado. Es un equipo que está bien entrenado y bien trabajado. La Copa nunca me estorba”, expresó el técnico catalán. Hidalgo está sorprendido de la evolución de Aubameyang: “Esa rodilla va bien”. El técnico deportivista sabe de la importancia del gabonés para su equipo. “Auba está bastante cerca. Pero aquí lo importante también es tener ese punto de cautela, escucharle mucho y cuando esté en plenas condiciones volverá. Lo cierto es que está tolerando más cargas en esa rodilla y esos momentos de recuperación. Esperemos que esté lo antes posible”. La cantera de Abegondo sigue ese crecimiento y Antonio Hidalgo está muy contento con el trabajo de los futbolistas del filial que entrenan con el primer equipo. “Están trabajando muy bien. Para este partido vendrán Noé, Rubén, Yayo, Martín Ochoa y Kevin. Del resto, iremos con el 90 por ciento de la plantilla seguro”, expresó el entrenador que puntualizó le va a dar minutos a Noé que es un futbolista en la que tiene puestas muchas esperanzas.

articles.title: Darragh MacAnthony "promises" Peterborough sale if not in top 10 by February
articles.summary: Peterborough United chairman and majority owner Darragh MacAnthony "promises" to sell the club if they are not in the League One top 10 by February.
articles.body:
Peterborough United chairman and majority owner Darragh MacAnthony says he "promises" he will sell his 75% stake in the club in February if they are not in the top 10 of the League One table by then.

Replying to a post on X , external following last night's 2-0 defeat at Bradford City in the Carabao Cup last-16, MacAnthony said: "I take full responsibility for all the squads built over my 20 years owning Posh.

"For some reason I have a lot of confidence in the current one. RS [Robbie Savage] will bring the best out of them & we as owners will support him in doing so.

"My promise to you the fans is always honesty, so I make a promise that if this squad isn't top 10 by February, I'll put my share of the club up for sale & let others take the baton with our wonderful club".

MacAnthony recently celebrated 20 years in charge at Peterborough and earlier this month appointed Savage as the club's new manager following the sacking of Luke Williams in September.

Savage won his first two games in charge, including a 3-1 win at Leicester City, but is now without a win in his last four in all competitions.

Posh are currently 21st in the League One table, one point from safety after 12 games, and host Luton Town in their next match on Saturday.

MacAnthony sold half his stake to Jason Neale and Stewart Thompson in 2018, through their Canadian business Kelgary Sports and Entertainment, but became sole majority shareholder again five years later after they stood down from the board.

articles.title: Bordalás, afectado tras el accidente en Toledo: “Es una noticia muy triste, ojalá no se vuelva a repetir”
articles.standfirst: El técnico azulón comparecía en sala de prensa en la previa del duelo frente a la Lebrijana de Copa del Rey
articles.summary: El técnico azulón comparecía en sala de prensa en la previa del duelo frente a la Lebrijana de Copa del Rey
articles.body: El entrenador del Getafe, José Bordalás, comparecía en sala de prensa con motivo del duelo de Copa del Rey frente a la UB Lebrijana. Antes de la comparecencia, el técnico, junto al equipo de comunicación y el resto de la prensa, guardaron un minuto de silencio en memoria de las víctimas del accidente de tren de Toledo. Accidente de Toledo: “Es una noticia muy triste, nos hemos enterado hoy poco antes de empezar la sesión de entrenamiento, es algo muy duro por lo que aconteció hace muy poco con el otro accidente donde murieron 46 personas. Mandar todo mi apoyo a familiares, mi más sentido pésame. Ojalá no se vuelva a repetir”. Copa del Rey: “Con mucha ilusión, siempre es una competición ilusionante para cualquier club, vamos a por la primera eliminatoria con el máximo respeto al rival, para ellos es un día muy especial, se han ganado estar ahí, lo afrontan con toda la ilusión. Nuestra intención es pasar”. Suspensión de la jornada de Copa: “Entiendo que se suspenda, es lógico después de una tragedia de esta magnitud que hemos vivido recientemente y se vuelve a repetir. Lo que se decida a partir de hoy lo acataremos y haremos lo que se nos diga. Está claro que es un momento difícil para todos”. Solidez defensiva: “Está claro que no estamos satisfechos, tenemos que recuperar identidad, esa solidez, hemos analizado. Hemos tenido poco tiempo, pero hemos visto imágenes, estamos todos disgustados por lo ocurrido, no queda otra que levantarse y recuperar nuestra mejor versión y la solidez defensiva no es normal”. Punto de inflexión: “Ojalá, pero como dije, con el máximo respeto, el fútbol demuestra que si no compites es difícil conseguir victorias y objetivos. Nos tenemos que centrar en el partido de mañana, recuperar nuestra mejor versión y sensaciones”. Problemas en balón parado: “Encajamos goles a balón parado en un partido, otro en otro, no podemos tolerar y permitirnos encajar tres goles a balón parado en el mismo partido, hemos hablado, tenemos que insistir en esa faceta porque si no nos penaliza”. Mangala y Zaid: “Vamos a ver si finalmente pueden estar, está claro que tenemos que analizar la carga de partidos, el momento y está claro que están en esa recta final. Han entrenado hoy, mañana decidiremos si estarán, si no de inicio, sí podrán participar en el transcurso. Tiene que haber obligatoriamente seis del primer equipo, intentaremos con las cargas dar descanso a alguno. Esto no para, el domingo tenemos un partido mucho más importante”. Juanmi: “Tenéis que preguntarle al cuerpo médico, realmente, ahora mismo, no os puedo decir el momento en que está. Hace ya un mes hablé con el chico, me dijo que estaba casi para estar con el grupo en el verde y no sé qué ha ocurrido posteriormente y me hablan de que tiene que estar otro mes más sin pisar el césped. Desconozco, no sé cuándo estará y si volverá a estar”. Andrés García: “Tiene que jugar en las dos posiciones, siempre les digo a los jugadores que no se pueden limitar, un jugador para jugar en diferentes posiciones le engrandece, al final el jugador quiere participar y ayudar, el equipo quiere recuperar las mejores sensaciones, yo tengo la confianza en que el equipo y ellos van a dar su mejor versión. Andrés, ojalá, siga en esa línea y siga creciendo. Puede darnos mucho más”. Identidad: “Estoy de acuerdo con las palabras de Martín, hablo mucho de ello con toda la plantilla. No sabría decirte el motivo pero tenemos que competir a mejor nivel, ser más solidarios. Si no trabajas y no corres cualquier rival te pinta la cara. Estamos en la obligación de competir mucho mejor y los jugadores son conscientes, todos lo somos. Ahora hay que pensar en el presente y no en el pasado”. Carvajal: “Vamos a ver, sinceramente, es un futbolista que ha estado muchos meses parado, viene sin hacer pretemporada como el resto de sus compañeros. Tenemos muchos jugadores que llegaron sin pretemporada y el riesgo es mayor. Tenemos que hablar con él y ver cuáles son sus sensaciones. Es un jugador que siempre quiere jugar, profesional y competitivo, pero no podemos asumir riesgos innecesarios”.

articles.title: Max Dowman red card: Arsenal's appeal against decision will fail, says former Premier League referee Dermot Gallagher
articles.summary: Max Dowman was shown a red card in Arsenal's Carabao Cup defeat to Fleetwood Town after he kicked out at Harrison Neal; Arsenal are appealing the decision and have to submit documents by 1pm on Thursday; Arsenal face Liverpool on Sunday, live on Sky Sports and want a decison before then
articles.body:
Dowman was sent off for violent conduct after kicking out at Harrison Neal following the defender's strong challenge on the teenager late in the fourth-round tie, which Arsenal lost on penalties.

Arsenal must submit appeal documents by 1pm on Thursday and are hopeful a decision will be made before their match at Liverpool, live on Sky Sports on Sunday.

However, when asked if he thought Arsenal's appeal would be successful, Gallagher told Sky Sports News : "I don't, because of the aggressiveness of Dowman, and you can see the intent. I think it will fail."

He added: "I think it is [a red card]. People are comparing it to Cole Palmer on Saturday (with Mateus Fernandes), I think Dowman is a little bit more aggressive.

"He knows what he's doing. He almost brings his knee up in a kicking action."

Gallagher believes Arsenal should also have been awarded a free-kick, and Neal a yellow card, for his tackle on Dowman.

"Although Neal gets the ball, he's too aggressive," said Gallagher. "It's a reckless challenge and he's had little regard to the safety of Dowman.

"Neal is not bothered whether he catches him afterwards. He was always going to get Dowman. He knows when he makes that tackle what he's going to do. That's enough for a free-kick and a yellow card."

Sky Sports' Paul Merson felt the red card was harsh, but that Dowman must be prepared to face strong challenges throughout his career.

"The tackle from the lad is an old-fashioned tackle. He gets the ball, follows through at the same time. In a way, I would say, it's a great tackle," he said.

"And then Dowman's retaliating. His foot's got caught. I don't think it's as bad as what everybody says. I think the reaction of the players has sort of made his decision.

"It's not that bad. In my opinion, it wasn't a red card. I don't think it should have been given.

"The kid's 16 years of age. Let's not get away from it. My worry is that at Arsenal, and when you play for one of the big clubs, which I found out later in my career, you get told once or twice, and that is it.

"And he's been told again. Obviously, Arteta's told him. He got sent off the other week for England against the USA. He's going to get that for the whole of his career. He's going to be kicked.

"People are going to look at the game now, and they're going to go, 'Right, we've got to upset him. Try and get inside him. Try and upset him'. And he's got to be better than that."

Merson and McAnuff question Arteta reaction

As Dowman headed towards the tunnel and past the dugouts, Mikel Arteta leaned in and said something to the teenager, which Merson criticised, saying the Arsenal manager should have put an arm around him.

Asked what he said to Dowman, Arteta told reporters: "It was something that we discussed before the game." Arteta refused to go into any more detail when pressed.

Asked whether Dowman has something to learn from the incident, Arteta replied: "We knew when we prepared the context of the match, we were very clear on the things to expect, the things that emotionally we have to dominate."

Reacting to the incident, Merson said: "If that's [Viktor] Gyokeres, who's an experienced international, he [Arteta] isn't doing that - but he does that to a 16-year-old kid?

"He's not the last person to get sent off for Arsenal, nor the first. If it was me, I'd have put my arm around him. It's still 1-1, they're still in the game.

"We all say things in life we wish we hadn't and if he [Arteta] could have that back, he'd do it differently."

Fellow Sky Sports pundit Jobi McAnuff said: "I can't understand the reaction. Arteta probably feels it was petulant, naive which I think it is.

"It is frustration from Dowman, but when you see the reaction from Arteta... we have to remember he's 16.

"Yes, he's a fantastic talent, but he will make mistakes along the way. I didn't like the reaction at all."

He added: "Dowman is potentially the future of Arsenal. Arteta didn't get that quite right."

articles.title: Terzic sobre Simón: "Es una historia maravillosa que demuestra que para ser el mejor del mundo no hay que marcharse del Athletic"
articles.standfirst: El técnico rojiblanco aprovecha para destacar el trabajo de Lezama con los porteros
articles.summary: El técnico rojiblanco aprovecha para destacar el trabajo de Lezama con los porteros
articles.body: El debut del Athletic esta temporada en Copa no aparece en la agenda de Simón, que descansará en esta primera eliminatoria tras una semana cargada de emociones y con el derbi con la Real Sociedad a las puertas. El recién elegido mejor portero del mundo es bandera del Athletic y Terzic, su entrenador, lo celebra. “La historia maravillosa es que ha demostrado que no tiene que marcharse de este club o de esta ciudad para ser el mejor del mundo. Lo puedes alcanzar aquí. Levantar el trofeo más grande como equipo (Mundial) y ser el mejor jugador en tu puesto se puede hacer desde este club maravilloso”, señaló el preparador alemán. El responsable técnico del primer equipo rojiblanco aprovechó para felicitar a los encargados del club en el trabajo con los guardametas; a Aitor Iru, preparador de porteros del primer equipo, y a los porteros Padilla y Santos, compañeros de Simón en la plantilla. “Les felicitamos enormemente. Padilla y Santos trabajan todos los días con él para que llegue al límite, igual que Aitor, nuestro entrenador de porteros. Hay que felicitar a todo el mundo que ha estado implicado en que alcance su siguiente nivel”, dijo. Terzic no pudo ser más sincero al añadir que “le tuve la semana sin el trofeo y para mí nada cambiará la apreciación sobre Simón. Ahora todo el mundo sabe lo que nosotros ya sabemos de antes. Estamos muy contentos de que uno de los nuestros ha llegado al más alto nivel, pero no tengo nada que ver con el trofeo porque yo me beneficio de su calidad”. En esta primera eliminatoria de Copa con el Prat las rotaciones de Terzic llegarán también a la portería, aunque no ha querido desvelar que Padilla será el portero titular del Athletic en Hospitalet. “Nunca hablo de convocatorias y alineaciones a un día de partido. Esta semana tenemos tres partidos y mañana habrá jugadores que puedan participar y brillar. No hablaré de nombres ni de jugadores en el once titular”, concluyó.
